name: Board Breaker
body:
You have trained to break boards, smash stone, and shatter metal.

Prerequisite: Ki pool class ability.

Benefit: When you make a weapon attack (including unarmed and natural weapon attacks) against inanimate objects or creatures of the elemental subtype, you can score a critical hit and deal additional damage (based on your attack’s critical damage multiplier) as long as you have at least one ki point left in your ki pool.

Normal: Inanimate objects and elementals are immune to critical hits.
